title: Assam Buranji, or A History of Assam (Enlarged Chronicle of Harakanta Barua Sadar-Amin)
title_english: Assam Buranji, or A History of Assam (Enlarged Chronicle of Harakanta Barua Sadar-Amin)
title_as: অসম বুৰঞ্জী: হৰকান্ত বৰুৱা সদৰ-আমীনৰ দ্বাৰা সম্প্ৰসাৰিত (১৯৩০)
author: Harakanta Barua Sadar-Amin & Kasinath Tamuli-Phukan / Edited by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan
category: Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS) Landmark Series
provenance: Shillong: Government of Assam / Gauhati: DHAS / Internet Archive (assam-buranji)
description: The definitive enlarged chronicle of Assam written by Harakanta Barua Sadar-Amin, based upon the foundational 1844 work of Kasinath Tamuli-Phukan and critically edited from multiple palm-leaf and sanchi-bark manuscripts by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan. Spans the complete history of the Tai in Assam from Chao Lung Sukapha's arrival in 1228 A.D. to the Treaty of Yandabo in 1826 A.D., featuring extensive accounts of Nora (Tai Khamyang) embassies, religious reforms, and military campaigns.
